observations: Justin is now a strong solution: his unusually specific account attaches him to poison-source breakage and disposal. A contaminated favor supports transfer into donor glass while public favor labeling prevents trivial recipient identification. Other guests could hypothetically have contaminated a packet first, but exact timing and corroboration are needed before treating that possibility as persuasive.
